step: after applying reply (i,t,G), every worker j with j = i or p.R <= s.count + 1 - s.iters j gets points j := x^{k+1}, starts j := t, iters j := k+1. Thus at the start of the next loop (iteration k+1, same instant t) every computation with delay (k+1) - iters j >= R is stopped and restarted at x^{k+1} (L502, L655). K = 0: query none immediately, output (x0, 0). No completion: reply none, state unchanged. n = 0: earliest over an empty list is none. R = 0 would restart everyone (excluded by the setups).

Repository definition: first time t >= s at which V t >= V s + 1 (none if never). With V = work v_i this is the universal-model completion time (L871).
Repository definition: right fold of earliestStep over a list of workers; returns the earliest completing worker, lowest index on ties.
